architecture.description:
HNetPay Portal

HNetExchange Service

HNetConnect Directory

Production Databases

Employee Devices

DB Access Layer

Production Servers

Backup Storage

Audit Logs

Third-Party Vendors

assumptions.content: Productions systems are replicated across three centers for high availability.
DB Access Layer is the single point of entry for all database queries from applications.
Employees travel with company-issued laptops and mobile devices containing sensitive data.
All external connections to the HNet services use HTTPS encryption.
Third-party Data center vendors have physical access to production servers.

mitigations.content: MFA will be required for all system access.
Least Privilege Access will be applied to grant users with the minimum required permissions.
Comprehensive audit logging will be used on all database access, user activity and system logs.
Web Application Firewall will be implemented on all the HNet applications.
Centralized database access prevents SQL injection through queries.
Production systems are replicated across the three different data centers.
Encryption will be on all corporate devices.
Badge readers and biometric scanners will be located at all data centers.

threats.statement: An internal actor who uses an unauthorized tool can store data within the tool, which leads to data exposure outside of company control, negatively impacting Production Databases and Employee Devices
threats.threatImpact: data exposure outside of company control

threats.statement: An external threat actor uses social engineering by impersonating IT support or a vendor can convince employees to revel non-critical information, which leads to information disclosure, negatively impacting Employee Trust
threats.prerequisites: uses social engineering by impersonating IT support or a vendor
threats.threatAction: convince employees to revel non-critical information

threats.statement: An external threat actor who exploits employees with outdated services and browsers can execute old vulnerabilities, which leads to malware infection on employee devices, negatively impacting Employee Devices
threats.prerequisites: who exploits employees with outdated services and browsers

threats.statement: An external threat actor who discovers an un-patched vulnerability in the web servers can exploit that vulnerability to gain code execution, which leads to complete server compromise allowing data theft and lateral movement, negatively impacting HNetExchange, HNetPay, HNetConnect, Production Servers and Production Databases
threats.prerequisites: who discovers an un-patched vulnerability in the web servers
threats.threatAction: exploit that vulnerability to gain code execution
threats.threatImpact: complete server compromise allowing data theft and lateral movement

threats.statement: An external threat actor that uses a DDoS service can flood our HNet Services, which leads to service down-time and stop medical message routing, negatively impacting HNetExchange, Production Servers and Patient Care
threats.threatImpact: service down-time and stop medical message routing

threats.statement: An external threat actor compromises the third-party vendor system can leverage privileged access to inject malware, which leads to compromise of the network and data, negatively impacting Production Servers, Third-Party Vendor, HNetExchange, HNetPay, HNetConnect and Customer Data
threats.threatAction: leverage privileged access to inject malware
threats.threatImpact: compromise of the network and data

threats.statement: An external threat actor with knowledge of SQL injection techniques can exploit web applications, which leads to unauthorized database access, negatively impacting Production Databases, HNetPay, HNetConnect, HNetExchange and Customer Data
threats.prerequisites: with knowledge of SQL injection techniques

threats.statement: A Natural Disaster that affects a data center with databases can destroy and disable production infrastructure, which leads to complete service outage, negatively impacting Production Servers, HNetExchange, HNetPay, HNetConnect, Patient Care and Production Databases
threats.prerequisites: that affects a data center with databases

threats.statement: An external threat actor who finds or steals an unencrypted company device can access cached credentials and company data, which leads to unauthorized access to production systems, negatively impacting Employee Devices, Production Databases and Customer Data
threats.prerequisites: who finds or steals an unencrypted company device
threats.threatAction: access cached credentials and company data

threats.statement: An internal actor with physical access to data can remove production servers, which leads to the theft of sensitive payment and patient data, resulting in reduced confidentiality and/or integrity of Production Servers, Production Databases and Operations
threats.threatImpact: the theft of sensitive payment and patient data
